name: 2024-25 Makeup - CHM 1071-ENGINEERING CHEMISTRY
subject: Engineering Chemistry

questions.markdown:
i) Explain the construction and working of calomel electrode. Write any two disadvantages of it.

ii) Write any two differences between galvanic and electrolytic cells.

i) A galvanic cell consists of iron plate immersed in 1.5 M FeSO$_4$ solution and copper plate immersed in 15 M solution of CuSO$_4$ at 298 K. If $E^o_{\text{cell}} = 1.56$ V. Write the cell reaction, cell representation and calculate the EMF of the cell.

ii) Give reason: Salt bridge is used in the construction of an electrochemical cell.

Give reasons for the following:

i) Oxidant must be free from traces of CO$_2$ in AFC.

ii) Weston cadmium cell is used for emf measurements.

i) A solution of Tryptophan has an absorbance at 280 nm of 0.54 in a 0.5 cm length cuvette. Given the absorbance coefficient of tryptophan is $6.4 \times 10^3$ L mol$^{-1}$ cm$^{-1}$. What is the concentration of solution?

ii) Explain the conductometric titration of strong acid Vs strong base with illustration.

i) Explain the desalination of brackish water using electrodialysis method.

ii) Write any two ways by which priming can be avoided in a boiler.
Discuss any two methods of removal of scales.

Mention any two distinguishing features between the following:

i) Cathodic and anodic protection methods of preventing corrosion.

ii) Galvanization and tinning.
Explain the phenomenon of caustic embrittlement in steel with relevant chemical reactions. Mention two methods of preventing it.

Explain the effect of the following factors on the rate of corrosion.

i) Nature of corrosion product

ii) Temperature.

i) How does the molecular weight of a polymer affect the glass transition temperature?

ii) A polymer sample has the following composition:
25 molecules of molecular mass each = 45,000
20 molecules of molecular mass each = 20,000
5 molecules of molecular mass each = 25,000
Calculate its number-average, weight-average molecular mass and polydispersity index of the polymer.

i) List the classification of liquid crystals based on shape.

ii) Describe the working principle of liquid crystal display in detail.
Explain the role of the matrix and the dispersed phase in composites.

i) The emf of the cell reaction Cd + 2AgCl $\rightarrow$ CdCl$_2$.5/2 H$_2$O + 2Ag is 0.6753 V and 0.6915 V at 298 K and 273 K. Calculate $\Delta H$ and $\Delta G$ at 298 K.

ii) Explain the electroless plating of copper with suitable reactions.

i) What are thin films? Write two differences between PVD and CVD techniques of obtaining thin films.

ii) How are polymers classified based on structure and tacticity.

i) Give reason: Corrosion is accelerated by deposition of dust or impurities in the crevices.

ii) Differentiate: Electrochemical series from Galvanic series.
